findings.statement: In 2016, Peter Nzioki appeared in the thriller film The CEO, where he played the role of 'Jomo'.
The film The CEO had its premier on 10 July 2016 at the Eko Hotels & Suites, Victoria Island, Lagos, and later received critical acclaim.
In 2016, Peter Nzioki was selected for the role as Kenyan crime lord 'Silas Kabaka' in the Netflix series Sense8.
